svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of a rebuild: a partition grown one split at a time has centres fixed before later chunks arrived, so a search that reads one posting finds only one of its query's three nearest chunks; the rebuild fits new centres with k-means over every chunk's code, publishes new empty postings while the old ones drain, copies every chunk to its nearest new posting without rewriting its code, and retires the old postings while keeping their centres; the same search then finds all three.
svg.text: A rebuild refits every posting at once, from the chunks' codes, and moves every chunk to its nearest new posting.
code written against its posting's centre
centre kept, no posting routes by it
◇ query, with its 3 nearest chunks ringed and the posting it reads outlined
POSTINGS AND THEIR SIZE, IN CHUNKS

g.text: retired: never searched, holds no chunks
retired: never searched, holds no chunks
retired: never searched, holds no chunks
This partition grew one split at a time. A posting's centre is fixed when the posting is created, and later chunks never move it.
A search reads only the posting nearest its query (1 here). It finds 1 of the query's 3 nearest chunks; the rest sit in a posting it does not read.
Rebuild, plan: k-means over every chunk's code fits 3 new centres. Nothing has moved yet.
Publish: 3 new postings start empty, and the old ones are draining. New chunks now go to the new postings.
Copy: every chunk moves to the new posting whose centre is nearest. No code is rewritten, so every chunk is now hollow.
Retire: the old postings are retired. Their centres stay stored, because the codes still refer to them.
The same search reads 1 posting again, and now finds all 3 of the query's nearest chunks.
A rebuild changes where chunks are filed, so searches find more. It rewrites no code, so centre drift goes up. Measure it with a recall check.

svg.text: Illustrative: searches read 1 posting (the default max_probes is 256), a split limit of 8 chunks, 2 dimensions instead of 768. The real rebuild fits its centres to the chunks' code reconstructions.
